title: Native Transition Recipe Authoring Workbench

decisionGates.description: After the first native UI can load two real songs, preview automation, and export a specific MixPlan, stop for user audition before expanding controls.
After the first assisted-anchor recipe export, ask the user whether the anchor workflow is understandable before adding more transition families.

subagentExecutionRules: Read this kiro.json, requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md, and all required steering context before executing tasks.
Build the authoring UI in the existing JUCE desktop app.
Use explicit per-deck audio/analyzed/debug-waveform file loading for v1.
Use debug-waveform JSON as the primary visual source; do not silently generate replacement waveform data in v1.
Keep rendered audio, real songs, local sessions, and exported user MixPlans out of git.
Do not introduce HTML, Electron, Tauri, or a new frontend runtime for this spec.
Stop at manual audition checkpoints and record the user's verdict before marking checkpoint tasks complete.
